gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing = because of.

gaps.lead: Yesterday, I informed my boss in writing that I would be leaving the company.
gaps.hint: inform your employer in writing = hand in your ___
gaps.explanation: 'Hand in one's notice' means formally resign.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen a better film this year.
gaps.sentence: This is ___ I've seen this year.
gaps.explanation: I haven't seen a better film = this is the best film (that) I've seen.

gaps.lead: Someone must check this equipment before every flight.
gaps.explanation: must check → must be checked (modal + be + past participle).

gaps.lead: The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.
